author: newbornsleepacademy
caption: Most parents think bath time is just about getting baby clean. 🧼  It’s not. Used properly, it can actually become one of the strongest cues your baby has for sleep. ✨  But here’s where it goes wrong… A bath on its own doesn’t fix night wakings. And it won’t magically calm an overtired baby. It only works when it sits in the right place in your evening. Because what matters isn’t just the bath… it’s what comes before it, and what happens after. If baby goes into the bath already overstimulated, or comes out into a rushed or chaotic feed… you’ve basically undone the whole thing. That’s why some babies seem “wired” after a bath instead of calm. It’s not the bath that’s the problem. It’s the flow around it. When the timing is right, the stimulation is right, and the transition out of the bath is calm… ✨ that’s when you see the shift. ✨  👉Calmer feeds. 👉Less resistance. 👉Longer stretches. Most parents aren’t doing it wrong. They’re just missing a couple of key pieces. If bath time hasn’t been working the way you expected, this is usually why. If you want to see how this actually fits into a full evening flow, I’ve broken it down step by step inside the Calmer Nights Blueprint, DM me CALM and I’ll send it through! 📥 video credit: camille_puericultrice
